intro: This quest is the fifth chapter in the investigation of the Tower of Althalaxx, leading Alliance adventurers south from Darkshore into Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier dispatches you to strike down Ilkrud Magthrull, an orc warlock residing at the corrupted Fire Scar Shrine, and retrieve his esoteric tome.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine, a place of
He had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a bit shaken up, friend. Are you well?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It was a grand thing you did today, friend. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
